# Nearly half of Americans describe the economy as poor, the highest share since 2022

Taylor Orth-October 14, 2026

The latest Economist / YouGov Poll finds that roughly half (49%) of Americans say the current state of the American economy is poor, the largest share since July 2022. Only 20% describe the economy as excellent (4%) or good (16%).

The Economist/YouGov survey was conducted Sept. 18-21 among 1,402 registered voters and has a margin of error of plus or minus 3.4 percentage points.

## An unpopular Trump boosts the left

Trump’s slipping approval numbers have placed Democrats in the driver's seat in polls ahead of November’s midterm elections. [...] A new Economist/YouGov poll released Sept. 22 found Trump's approval rating fell five points in a single week, from 40% to 35%, wiping out five straight weeks of gains in the same poll. The drop leaves him just two points above the lowest rating he's ever recorded in the survey and comes as Republicans enter the final stretch before November's midterm elections.
